Use this pull request template for all merges into main branches.

Instructions for this file:
1) Provide a short Summary of the change and the motivation.
2) Checklist: include items for testing, data quality checks, docs updates, and migration considerations.
3) Migration / Runbook: document deployment steps and rollback plan if schema changes are included.
4) Add Related tickets and reviewers who must sign off (data owners, infra).

Ensure DQ results and sample queries demonstrating correctness are attached to the PR.
